text: Assumption: E_OK confirms the successful initiation of the start command in view of asynchronous execution — is this correct?

norm: e_ok confirms the successful initiation of the start command in view of asynchronous execution
assumption: E_OK confirms the successful initiation of the start command in view of asynchronous execution.
rationale: The specification defines the service as asynchronous and the return value E_OK as 'API call finished successfully', but documents no separate status queries in the present payload.

original.text: Annahme: Angesichts der asynchronen Ausführung dürfte E_OK die erfolgreiche Initiierung des Startbefehls bestätigen — trifft das zu?
